classification_meaning.different_structure: Different input/state/output obligations; not a claim of pretraining novelty or statistical independence.
classification_meaning.shared_mechanism: Shared repair mechanism with specified additional obligations; actual minimum patch still needs review.
classification_meaning.near_template: A potentially near-identical minimum repair requires explicit adjudication, not automatic admission.

tasks.mechanics: Expire accepted reservations before sequential admission; equality and rejected-state handling interact.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Make each admission read only reservations still valid at the current time, by moving expiration filtering before occupancy or filtering within the occupancy sum; preserve exact-capacity and accepted-only accounting.

tasks.mechanics: Project data-only logical addresses across ignored control blocks, preserving zero output positions.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Do not advance logical address for control blocks; retain half-open coverage.

tasks.mechanics: Clip weighted intervals and add their contributions over a bounded integer domain.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Replace discarding partially exterior intervals with correct clipping.

tasks.mechanics: Independent interleaved transaction lifetimes; commit emits, rollback discards, ID reuse resets.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Restore transaction ownership of amounts so one ID add or termination cannot change peers net amounts; allow independent per-ID totals, shared-ledger snapshot compensation, or lifetime-log recomputation. Begin and terminal ID lookup and commit order are already correct.

tasks.mechanics: Per-key high-water marks ignore older/duplicate numbers and reset locally on reconnection.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Reset the addressed key high-water state without resetting other keys.

tasks.mechanics: Inner reset clears current sum only; outer delimiter clears sum and peak; empty and negative peaks remain distinct.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Preserve the group's historical peak when resetting the inner running sum.

tasks.mechanics: Sequential multiset orders with all-or-nothing stock changes and empty-order success.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Prevent partial consumption by rejected orders, not merely add per-item deletion.

tasks.mechanics: Count distinct source memberships per label, threshold counts and sort qualifying labels.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Deduplicate within each source, not globally, before accumulating source votes.

tasks.mechanics: Count cross-side equal-value index products excluding same-source pairs.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Retain repeated records as distinct indices instead of set-deduplicating each side.

tasks.mechanics: Refresh existing keys and evict oldest on insertion, returning every eviction and final order.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Move a refreshed resident key to the newest position before future eviction.
tasks.concern: Per-prefix last-occurrence reconstruction is possible; actual repair must not be accepted solely because the output wrapper changed.

tasks.mechanics: All valid votes count, invalid votes set no first-valid position; rank by count then first-valid order.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Do not let invalid votes establish candidate tie order.

tasks.mechanics: Select by priority with per-category quotas, then restore original index order without label deduplication.
tasks.initial_repair_obligation: Consume quotas in priority order rather than original input order.

Votes do not consume inventory or depend on demand fulfillment.
Stable tie behavior is shared, but invalid events must not establish position and all candidates are ranked.
First occurrence matters only after validity filtering; duplicate valid votes alter ranking instead of being discarded.
C12: Priority and category quota determine selection, not a time-threshold prefix.

Category counts constrain selection but do not calculate bag intersections.

Priority ties use indices, but multiple category limits and output reordering go beyond choosing one earliest maximum.
Labels are not deduplicated; selected original record indices are preserved and sorted.
